home.title: Welcome to Soplos Linux
home.description: You are in a live session: nothing is installed or changed until you decide. Try the system at your own pace, install it when you are ready, or repair one you already have.

install.title: Install
install.description: Install Soplos on this computer. You can keep what you have or start from scratch.

rescue.title: Repair
rescue.description: If your computer does not start or you forgot the password, it is fixed here without knowing any command.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Partition disks, see your hardware and adjust the screen of this session.

intro.title: {name} installer
intro.description: It guides you through the language, the disks and your user. Before it changes anything it shows a summary and asks you to confirm.

checks.title: Before you start
checks.powerBattery: On battery: plug in the charger

clock.hint: The clock of this computer does not match the servers. The installer stops with error 100 when the time is wrong.

warn.title: The installation may fail
warn.internet: There is no connection to the Soplos servers.
warn.clock: The clock of this computer is {minutes} minutes off.
warn.error100: The installer downloads packages while it works, and stops with error 100 if it cannot.

notFound.title: Installer not found
notFound.message: The {name} installer could not be found. Install it or run the installation manually.

rescue.question: What happened?
rescue.advanced: Advanced: open a terminal in an installed system

hints.boot: Installs the bootloader again and makes the boot menu again. It only touches the boot partition and /boot.
hints.password: Changes the password of the user you choose. It does not touch their files.
hints.update: Rebuilds the start-up files of every kernel and makes the boot menu again. It only touches /boot.

rescue.chooseSystem: Which one do you want to repair?

boot.title: My computer does not start
boot.description: Black screen or an error when turning it on

password.title: I forgot my password
password.description: Choose a user and set a new password

update.title: It broke after an update
update.description: Rebuilds what is needed to start again

none.title: No installed system found
none.message: No Linux system was found on the disks of this computer. Check that the disk is connected and try again.

working.boot: Repairing the start of your computer

boot.title: Done, your computer can start again
boot.message: Restart and remove this USB when the computer turns off.

password.title: Password changed
password.message: You can now sign in with the new password.

update.title: Done, the system was repaired
update.message: Restart and remove this USB when the computer turns off.

terminal.title: Recovery terminal of the installed system
terminal.exit: Type exit or press Ctrl+D to leave

terminalOpen.title: The terminal is open
terminalOpen.message: The system closes by itself when you leave the terminal.

failed.title: It could not be repaired
failed.message: Something went wrong and nothing was left half done. The details below say what failed.

gparted.title: GParted
gparted.description: Create, move and delete partitions before installing.

hardware.title: Hardware information
hardware.description: Processor, memory and disks of this computer.

resolution.title: Screen resolution
resolution.description: It only changes this live session.
resolution.unsupported: Not available on this desktop yet.

numlock.title: NumLock
numlock.description: Turn NumLock on in the installed system. It is better off on laptops without a numeric keypad.
numlock.enabledText: NumLock will be turned on automatically in the installed system.
numlock.disabledText:
NumLock will not be turned on in the installed system.
Recommended for laptops without a numeric keypad.

language.description: Change the language and the keyboard layout of the system. The session restarts by itself to apply them.
language.keyboardHint: It follows the language you choose, but you can change it on its own.
language.restartNote: Save what you have open: the session closes and opens again.
